. The Order Was Canceled After Preparation Started (Merchant Protection)

• How it happens: A customer or support agent cancels the order on Uber Eats after your kitchen had already accepted and started preparing it.
• Why Uber Eats paid: Under Uber Eats' merchant policy, if an order is canceled past a certain prep threshold, Uber Eats still pays you for the food cost even though the order status displays as "Canceled" or "Voided" on the tablet and syncs to your POS as a void.
• POS effect: Your POS integration (e.g., Toast, Square, Clover, Deliverect) receives the "Canceled" webhook and automatically voids the check so your daily sales reporting doesn't inflate, leaving you with a $0 POS ticket and a positive payout on Uber Eats.
